## 0.1.21 (August 13, 2026)

NOTES:

* The provider is generated from the [waggle](https://github.com/GlueOps/waggle) repository and everything under `internal/` carries a `DO NOT EDIT` header. Fixes belong in that repo's generator passes or overlays; edits made here are reverted by the next regeneration. ([#45](https://github.com/glueops/terraform-provider-waggle/issues/45))

ENHANCEMENTS:

* `id` and `created_at` no longer show as "(known after apply)" when an unrelated attribute changes. They are server-assigned and fixed for the life of the resource, so the plan now carries the prior value forward. ([#45](https://github.com/glueops/terraform-provider-waggle/issues/45))

BUG FIXES:

* `waggle_pools`: `datacenter_id`, `name`, `slot_id` and `metadata` now force replacement. The API binds only `desired_count` on `PATCH /pools/{id}`, so changing any of the others planned an in-place update the provider could not perform and apply failed with "Provider produced inconsistent result after apply". ([#45](https://github.com/glueops/terraform-provider-waggle/issues/45))
* `waggle_placements`: `placement_id` now forces replacement. Adopting a different placement is a different resource; the only write the API accepts there is the vmid backfill. ([#45](https://github.com/glueops/terraform-provider-waggle/issues/45))
* `waggle_datacenters`, `waggle_hypervisors`, `waggle_organizations` and `waggle_slots`: build the update request URL from state rather than the plan. A computed `id` is not guaranteed known during an update, and an unknown one collapsed the path to `/datacenters/`, which the API answers with an HTML 404 that surfaced as an unintelligible parse error. ([#45](https://github.com/glueops/terraform-provider-waggle/issues/45))
* `waggle_pools`: `metadata` is now sent on create and refreshed on read. It was advertised in the schema and the examples but mapped in neither direction, so input was silently discarded while Terraform reported success. It is typed as normalized JSON, so key ordering and whitespace no longer produce a diff. ([#45](https://github.com/glueops/terraform-provider-waggle/issues/45))
